feature: Added the Pinyin4j plugin service with plugin ID `pinyin4j` and engine `pinyin4j`
Added host discovery and invocation through `org.autojs.plugin.PINYIN4J`
Supported `pinyin4j.of(text, options)` for converting Chinese text to Hanyu Pinyin with configurable case type, tone type, `ü` representation, and separator
Supported `pinyin4j.asTone(text)` for converting tone-number pinyin to tone-mark pinyin

Added localized plugin metadata and usage instructions for Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
Added JSON-driven README and CHANGELOG generation through `.python/generate_markdown.py`
